1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETERS UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED
3. SHELL PANELS: CARBON FIBER REINFORCED POLYMER, 2mm THICK, MODULAR SNAP-FIT
4. SKIN: MEDICAL-GRADE SILICONE, 3mm THICK, UV-RESISTANT, REPLACEABLE
5. RF-TRANSPARENT PANELS: UHMWPE AT STARLINK AND ANTENNA LOCATIONS
6. ALL WIRING: MIL-SPEC SHIELDED, FLAME-RETARDANT, ROUTED THROUGH FRAME CHANNELS
8. TOTAL COMPONENT COUNT: ~1,000 PARTS (SEE BOM DRAWING BODY-001-BOM)
9. ASSEMBLY SEQUENCE: FRAME -> MOTORS -> WIRING -> ESCU -> SERVER -> SENSORS -> SHELL -> SKIN
10. EMERGENCY STOP: RECESSED BUTTON ON BACK OF NECK + WIRELESS RF FOB + VOICE COMMAND
11. COOLANT: 3.5% NaCl SALTWATER, 120mL TOTAL VOLUME, COUNTER-FLOW ROUTING
